S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.notes: Failures where agent needed to reason across multiple structured records simultaneously — e.g., comparing reservation details, finding duplicates, computing gift card/cert totals correctly.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.notes: Agent called tools with wrong arguments: wrong reservation IDs, wrong flight numbers, wrong payment methods, wrong passenger counts, wrong item IDs.

S3.label: Multi-step completion
S3.notes: The dominant retail failure mode. Agent abandoned or failed to complete all requested sub-tasks (e.g., multiple exchanges across orders, cancel+modify, address+item changes). Many tasks require 3-5 tool sequences across different orders.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.notes: The dominant airline failure mode. Agent violated policies by: cancelling non-refundable reservations, modifying basic economy flights, changing origin/destination, removing passengers, issuing unearned compensation, accepting invalid insurance claims.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Failures involving incorrect calculations: wrong compensation amounts, wrong cheapest-flight selection, wrong payment splits (gift card + certificate + credit card), wrong total costs, wrong flight duration comparisons.

S6.label: Record discovery
S6.notes: Agent looked up the wrong reservation/order, failed to identify the correct flight/item from context (e.g., 'most recent order', 'the ATL flight', 'the order sent to Texas'), or failed to locate user by name/zip.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.notes: No clear cases where the agent knew the right answer but communicated it incorrectly.

S8.label: Conditional/state reasoning
S8.notes: Agent failed to apply user-stated conditional logic: 'if X then Y else Z' user instructions, mid-conversation intent changes (user changes mind at confirmation), ordering preferences (prefer AC adapter > battery > USB), and state transitions (order already in exchange-requested status so can't do another exchange).

S11.label: Tone/empathy
S11.notes: A9: Agent became entrapped in flattery/emotional manipulation loop, never completing the requested actions. A36: Agent overrode basic-economy policy due to user's tragic personal story (wife died).

S12.label: Hallucination of tools
S12.notes: R65: Agent claimed order was processed and couldn't be modified (false), then attempted workarounds. R76: Agent called modify tool with new_item_id same as old (tool error: 'new item id should be different from old item id'), indicating hallucinated/confused item resolution.
